purpose: Static scene map for the fair planner: occupancy, desk and bookcase boxes, cubby boxes from the bookcase asset, book-model extents, desk-top height and visual edges, robot-frame height.
not_used: Scored seeds 301, 302 and 303 were not used. The map stores no book world poses from any episode, only the three book models (root-frame extents).

dumps.collector: oracle_ag (sweep,turn,land,putback) writing observation dumps; the collector is not the fair planner

truth_offline_only: Each dump's truth_base, truth_* boxes and book local extents are read by build_map.py to place the camera and to copy static geometry. The planner never opens those dumps and never reads simulator state.
asset_geometry: bookcase container boxes from the task export scene_geometry.json, shifted onto the training-median case pose
